KBank — Bacterial Surface Glycan & Biosynthetic Locus Curation

Streaming, parsing, and canonicalizing bacterial surface polysaccharides across CSDB, KEGG Glycan, ECODAB, CERMAV EPS-DB, EK3D, and GlyTouCan via [kbank.io][kbank.io], paired de novo with [SeroGen][serogen.loci.LocusPredictor] biosynthetic gene clusters and [BiosyntheticAssigner][kbank.biosynthesis.BiosyntheticAssigner] alignments.

1. Multi-Database Surface Antigen Coverage & Taxonomic Distribution

Consolidating repeating O-antigens, capsular polysaccharides (CPS/K-antigens), exopolysaccharides (EPS), and lipooligosaccharides (LOS) across CSDB, KEGG, ECODAB, EPS-DB, and EK3D, with 4-tier NCBI Assembly and nucleotide BGC resolution.

2. Monosaccharide, Substituent Modifier & Glycosidic Linkage Repertoire

Distribution of the top 18 monosaccharide/modifier nodes (Sugars) and glycosidic linkages (LinkageType) encoded in KBank's packed 16-bit CSR chemical graph representation.

3. SeroGen LocusArchetype & Bipartite GeneRole → Glycan Component Alignment

Automated assignment of biosynthetic pathway archetypes (CPS_WZY, LPS_WZY, LPS_ABC, CPS_ABC, CPS_SYNTHASE) and stoichiometric enzyme-to-glycan mappings across LINKAGE, MONOSACCHARIDE, MODIFIED_MONO, and REDUCING_END targets.

4. Source Database Synthesis & Bipartite Alignment Evidence Tiers

Cross-referencing structural databases with PanGraphConsensusPrior homology-transfer and Hungarian bipartite graph alignment.
